verdict.rationale: Nitrokey documents an official CLI, nitropy. A runtime probe confirmed it installs from PyPI (pynitrokey) and identifies itself as 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices', version 0.13.0. missing for 10: in-depth evidence of command coverage beyond the docs page title, documented scriptable or machine-readable output suited to AI or agent workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Nitrokey's official nitropy CLI installs keylessly from PyPI and identifies itself — `uvx --from pynitrokey nitropy version` → 'Command line tool to interact with Nitrokey devices' / 0.13.0.
